reviewed_extensions.scope: Service deploy role read-only bake-gate grants; CloudWatch alarm ARNs in colon form; worker metric-filter grants; FilterLogEvents on both worker log-group resource forms, on top of the #158 rounds
reviewed_extensions.detail: On top of main's round-10 to round-16 #158 statements (logs:DescribeLogGroups wildcard, Step Functions state-machine reads, CleanupOperation role iam:GetRole, record-job install contract), the Service deploy role adds: cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics; cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms on arn:aws:cloudwatch:ap-east-1:650880818323:alarm:beta-anywear-*; ecs:DescribeServices on the two workload services; sqs:GetQueueAttributes on the four stage queues; logs:FilterLogEvents on both the plain and stream-suffixed worker log-group ARNs. The CloudFormation execution role's existing alarm grant moves to the colon alarm ARN and gains logs:PutMetricFilter, logs:DescribeMetricFilters and logs:DeleteMetricFilter on the worker log-group ARN. No SQS send/receive grant and no new resource family.

reviewed_extensions.scope: CleanupOperation task-definition and iam:PassRole grants on the Service CloudFormation execution role
reviewed_extensions.detail: The Workload template registers beta-anywear-cleanup and beta-anywear-cleanup-verify task definitions alongside api/worker; the CFN execution role's task-definition statement adds those two family ARNs. The three one-shot task roles beta-anywear-tester-cleanup-task, beta-anywear-verification-task and beta-anywear-one-shot-execution are added to iam:PassRole only (they are Workload-owned, not created/deleted by this role). No wildcard, no other role and no new action.

reviewed_extensions.scope: CleanupOperation StateMachine update/version and states PassRole grants on the Service CloudFormation execution role
reviewed_extensions.detail: The Workload state machine definition changes with the task definitions, so the CFN role needs states:UpdateStateMachine; create/delete and version publish/delete cover replacement, and CreateStateMachine is the one service-level action on * because Step Functions defines no resource type for it. iam:PassRole for the Workload-owned beta-anywear-tester-cleanup-operation role is constrained to states.amazonaws.com. No other role, action or wildcard.

reviewed_extensions.scope: Inline-policy actions on the Foundation-managed E2E qualification and Infra runtime roles
reviewed_extensions.detail: The Workload template attaches/updates inline policies on beta-e2e-qualification-role and beta-infra-runtime-role, so the CFN execution role needs exactly iam:PutRolePolicy, iam:GetRolePolicy and iam:DeleteRolePolicy on those two concrete roles. No create/delete/read of the roles and no other role.

reviewed_extensions.scope: Service deploy and CloudFormation execution roles scoped to AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta (was AnyWearWorkloadStack-beta); maintenance-bucket ARN follows the Runtime stack generated name
reviewed_extensions.detail: Issue #166 renames the Service-owned release slice to AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta and moves the persistent VPC/Aurora/S3/Cognito/ECR/SQS/SSM/CloudFront state into the Base stack. Both Foundation Service deploy roles keep every existing action; only the CloudFormation stack scope string and the maintenance-bucket name prefix change to the Runtime identity. These are source-side reviewed additions, not deployed: the fixture records the delta the synthesized Foundation adds on top of the still-authenticated live original. publication_verified and deployment_qualified stay false until the Deployment gate deploys Foundation.

reviewed_extensions.scope: beta-infra-runtime-role CloudFormation read grants for the M4 Base-deploy origin pre-read: DescribeStacks and GetTemplate on AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta (permanent) and AnyWearWorkloadStack-beta (transitional)
reviewed_extensions.detail: The runtime role resolves the Base deploy origin before the Base update that would install its new DedicatedPolicy. The live runtime-role policy covers Foundation/Platform/Workload only, so the initial M4 read of AnyWearRuntimeStack-beta would be AccessDenied, and after M4 the new Base policy drops Workload, so a stopped-state deploy would fail the Workload read. Foundation therefore owns these two read-only grants and the step-8 Foundation deploy installs them before M4. Runtime is permanent (an absent stack is a ValidationError that still requires authorization); Workload is transitional until M3/M4 deletes it and a later reviewed Foundation deploy removes the ARN. Source-side only: not live, publication_verified and deployment_qualified stay false.

reviewed_extensions.scope: beta-service-deploy-cfn-role Secrets Manager dynamic-reference read for the API distribution OriginCustomHeaders (cloudfront_origin_header)
reviewed_extensions.detail: Stage A first updates the moved API distribution, whose OriginCustomHeaders carries a {{resolve:secretsmanager:/anywear/beta/cloudfront_origin_header}} dynamic reference. CloudFormation re-resolves that reference on every update of the resource under the Workload stack execution role; the role had no Secrets Manager action, so the update rolled back. Foundation adds exactly secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on arn:aws:secretsmanager:ap-east-1:650880818323:secret:/anywear/beta/cloudfront_origin_header-*; no other secret, action, wildcard, condition, managed policy or role. Source-side only, not live: publication_verified and deployment_qualified stay false. The statement is removed by a later reviewed Foundation deploy after the MOVE deletes the Workload stack.

reviewed_extensions.scope: M6 rollback grants on beta-service-deploy-cfn-role: cleanup state-machine tagging and any-resource ECS task-definition deregistration
reviewed_extensions.detail: CDK applies the stack tags on state-machine create/rollback, so the Service CloudFormation execution role needs states:TagResource and states:UntagResource on the fixed cleanup state machine arn:aws:states:ap-east-1:650880818323:stateMachine:beta-anywear-tester-cleanup. ECS evaluates ecs:DeregisterTaskDefinition against * regardless of the task-definition ARN, so the existing family-scoped statement never authorizes rollback or stack deletion; a separate ecs:DeregisterTaskDefinition statement on * covers only that path. Both statements carry Sids so CDK policy minimization cannot merge them with unrelated wildcard/state-machine statements. No other action, role or wildcard; every existing statement is unchanged and the family-scoped task-definition statement stays. Source-side only, not live: publication_verified and deployment_qualified stay false until the Deployment gate deploys Foundation. The grants are needed only for rollback/stack deletion and remain until a later reviewed Foundation deploy removes them.

reviewed_extensions.scope: M6 ELB create grants on beta-service-deploy-cfn-role: listener actions on the load-balancer ARN and rule actions on the listener ARN
reviewed_extensions.detail: ELB authorizes CreateListener against the load balancer ARN because the listener ARN does not exist until creation returns, and CreateRule against the listener ARN because the listener-rule ARN does not exist until creation returns. Foundation adds exactly two statements: elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener/DeleteListener/ModifyListener on arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-east-1:650880818323:loadbalancer/app/beta-anywear-api/*, and CreateRule/DeleteRule/ModifyRule on arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-east-1:650880818323:listener/app/beta-anywear-api/*. Both carry Sids so policy minimization cannot merge them; the existing listener- and listener-rule-scoped statements stay for the update/delete paths. No other action, role or wildcard. Source-side only, not live: publication_verified and deployment_qualified stay false until the Deployment gate deploys Foundation.
